answer: In this PoA design, every identity locks bonded collateral in an escrow, and cryptographic evidence of correlated equivocation across k identities imposes a quadratic penalty, O(k²), instead of k separate fines. Once a sybil swarm is detected, linked escrows, rewards, and future earning capacity undergo asymmetric depreciation with an exponential multiplier in capital loss, so coordination becomes uneconomic. Names such as saffron, crystal, and jetty cannot evade linkage.
